fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of "RjvPlatform.dll" by "SystemResetPlatform.exe" located in a non-default location.
fields.name: Potential RjvPlatform.DLL Sideloading From Non-Default Location
fields.query: event.type="Module Load" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((module.path contains "\\RjvPlatform.dll" and src.process.image.path="\\SystemResetPlatform.exe") and (not src.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows\\System32\\SystemResetPlatform\\")))
